title: College can cost $100,000 a year. Here's how families are covering the tab
summary: As the cost of college education continues to soar, reaching up to $100,000 annually, families are increasingly reliant on various forms of financial aid. Both federal and private assistance programs have become essential for many students and their parents in managing these expenses. This trend highlights the growing concern over affordability in higher education and the financial strategies families must adopt to ensure access to college.
